description: The phone shell (DESIGN.md, Screen): a TsuyaSurface (ambient or the neutral glow, with grain); builder builds the scrolling content, padded by the EdgeInsets it is given (the safe areas, the TsuyaSpace.s20 side margins, and room for dock, at whatever height it takes); dock floats TsuyaSpace.s12 from the edges above the safe area, the content fading into TsuyaColors.bg under it. On Flutter, also the keyboard: the content's own height shrinks by MediaQuery.viewInsetsOf's bottom inset, so a focused field's own "scroll into view" lands it above the keyboard instead of under it.

constructors.description: A shell lit by ambient (or the neutral glow without one), builder building the scrolling content, dock floating over it.

params.name: ambient
params.description: The leading content's picture, lighting the top; without one, the neutral glow.

params.name: builder
params.description: Builds the scrolling content (a ListView or a CustomScrollView, say) padded by the given EdgeInsets. Leave its own `controller` unset so it picks up the nearest PrimaryScrollController — the one Screen itself sets up — letting dock's tab bar scroll it to the top.

params.name: dock
params.description: A tab bar, floating over the content.
